source.title: CBKC Brazilian Campeiro Bulldog standard10.08.2025
source.paraphrase: Medium robust agile dog, body slightly longer than tall. Broad head and short square muzzle; no excessive head wrinkles. Thick hanging lips and limited dewlap are allowed. Strong medium neck, fitted body skin, short smooth hair; natural short low-set tapering tail. Small high-set pendant ears; open nostrils. All colours except merle allowed.

confirmedDefect: Deep forehead folds and loose cheek/neck skin underexpress the moderate-skin requirement; body mass and mastiff classification alone are not defects.
